mapper.select: select from mst_cust c where c.cust_id = #{id}
select exists (select 1 from mst_cust where cust_cd = #{custCd} and cust_id <> #{exceptId})

insert into mst_cust (comp_cd, cust_cd, cust_nm, cust_type, biz_no, ceo_nm, tel, email, addr, remark, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.custCd}, #{f.custNm}, #{f.custType}, #{f.bizNo}, #{f.ceoNm}, #{f.tel}, #{f.email}, #{f.addr}, #{f.remark}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning cust_id
mapper.update: update mst_cust set use_yn = 'N', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where cust_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
update mst_cust set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where cust_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select contact_id, cust_id, contact_nm, dept_nm, tel, email, main_yn, row_ver from mst_cust_contact where cust_id = #{custId} and use_yn = 'Y' order by main_yn desc, contact_id

insert into mst_cust_contact (comp_cd, cust_id, contact_nm, dept_nm, tel, email, main_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{custId}, #{c.contactNm}, #{c.deptNm}, #{c.tel}, #{c.email}, #{c.mainYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning contact_id
mapper.update: update mst_cust_contact set use_yn = 'N', main_yn = 'N', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where contact_id = #{id} and cust_id = #{custId} and use_yn = 'Y' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
